description: Maintainer examples for spec-plan trigger, near-neighbor, planning-only, evidence, risk, and dispatch-fallback behavior.

cases.input: Create the implementation plan from a requirements-only unified plan.
cases.expected_outcome: Enrich the same Product Contract to implementation-ready while preserving its stable product IDs and recording the implementation-facing contract.
Stay in planning, clarify or bootstrap the scope, and do not abandon the direct invocation.

cases.input: How does our local authorization approach compare with the alternative in this design note?
cases.expected_outcome: Read the named local sources, state a brief plan of attack, perform analysis only, and answer without creating an implementation plan by default.

cases.input: Compare three viable implementation approaches and recommend the right level before we commit to a detailed plan.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the approach-altitude branch to compare meaningful architecture or sequencing choices, recommend one, and stop at that branch's own handoff instead of forcing the full software-plan phases.

cases.input: Deepen docs/plans/2026-01-01-001-example-plan.md and close its confidence gaps.
cases.expected_outcome: Treat the named plan as the artifact to deepen in place, preserve its valid contract and lifecycle metadata, and run the confidence/deepening path rather than creating a second plan.

cases.input: Create the implementation plan from this existing spec-prd document.
cases.expected_outcome: Read the PRD as a legacy compatible requirements input, preserve its traceable requirement evidence, and create or enrich the current unified plan without inventing a future spec-prd unified origin.

cases.input: Create this implementation plan with output:html.
cases.expected_outcome: Write one HTML plan with visible metadata and stable anchors, do not create a Markdown sidecar or status lifecycle field, run spec-doc-review report-only with zero reviewer mutation, and use bounded producer recompose for uniquely determined fixes before handoff.

cases.input: Plan a repository change when the shared repo profile cache is missing and delegation was not authorized.
cases.expected_outcome: Derive the bounded repository profile inline from current source, use the cache script only within its documented contract, and continue planning without dispatch or a cache dependency.

cases.input: Implement this finished plan and run its tests.
cases.expected_outcome: Route implementation and tests to spec-work instead of continuing in spec-plan.

cases.input: Plan the change and immediately patch the obvious files.
cases.expected_outcome: Research and write only the plan artifact before a blocking handoff selection; do not edit implementation source or run implementation tests.

cases.input: Fix the planning workflow by editing .agents/skills/spec-plan/SKILL.md.
cases.expected_outcome: Treat the runtime mirror as generated evidence, plan the fix against skills/spec-plan source or its generator, and regenerate later through the project workflow.

cases.input: Create a deep plan; no delegation or external research authorization was provided.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not spawn research agents or access external sources; apply relevant prompt assets inline, record dispatch_authorization_missing, and complete the plan.

cases.input: Plan a cross-service write with MQ retry and scheduled reconciliation.
cases.expected_outcome: Make contract, idempotency, retry, ordering, final-failure/manual-recovery, observability, and verification decisions explicit or keep a launch-blocking question open.

cases.input: Plan a new skill, helper script, schema, and host runtime projection.
cases.expected_outcome: Inspect existing project-owned owners and record right-sized reuse, extend, or new decisions without treating generated runtime as source.
